name: DiscordDeck
author: Lexodeus

publish.description: Adds Discord to the Steam menu. Opens Discord or Vesktop (Vencord) installed from Discover without adding it as a non-Steam game.

Changelog:
## 0.1.2 (2026-10-17)

### Fixes

- The D-pad works on Steam's keyboard every time after Steam + X. Before, it sometimes couldn't move between keys.
- Leaving or reloading the plugin no longer leaves a background process running on the Steam Machine.
